exposure: Mode of conception (IVF vs. natural conception)
Frozen embryo transfer (FET) vs. fresh embryo transfer (ET)
outcome: Gestational age at diagnosis of HDP
finding: Singleton pregnancies with HDP conceived through IVF experienced higher rates of early-onset and severe preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm birth, and lower gestational age at delivery and birthweight compared to natural conception.
birth_weight: Neonates in the IVF group had lower birthweight compared to the NC group
